title: Understanding Silhouette Score
text: The silhouette score measures how similar a point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. A negative silhouette score indicates that a point is closer to a neighboring cluster than to its own cluster.

title: Analyzing Clustering C

title: Identifying Points with Negative Silhouette Score
text: In Clustering C, identify if there is a point that is closer to a different cluster than its own. This would indicate a negative silhouette score.
